name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is the European Parliament's wish list for the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, in 2026. It is not a law and changes nothing by itself. It asks countries to cut emissions faster, move away from fossil fuels, and pay more to help poorer countries cope with climate damage. It also asks the EU to do more at home, including setting a clear 2040 target and sending it to the United Nations on time.

**Key points**

- No law changes; Parliament sets out demands for COP31 and for EU climate policy.
- Affects EU governments, the Commission, and developing countries seeking climate money.
- Next: the EU delegation takes these positions into the Antalya talks.
